subject.title: Feature Request: Add cumulative history search and multi-account support

question: Should wacrawl preserve point-in-time archives and add federated historical search first, or change the primary archive to cumulative merge semantics, and should named multi-account profiles be split into a separate delivery track?
rationale: The alternatives create different persistent identity, deletion, migration, backup, storage, and interface contracts that current code and documentation do not settle.

options.title: Federate snapshots, split profiles
options.body: Keep current snapshot and restoration semantics, design account-scoped identity, deliver cross-snapshot search first, and track named account profiles separately.

options.title: Build cumulative archive model
options.body: Retain and reconcile historical rows during import, with explicit migrations and compatibility proof for backup, restoration, deletion, and existing setups.

options.title: Profiles and federation together
options.body: Design a unified profile registry whose search spans every profile and snapshot, accepting a larger multi-area implementation and migration effort.

recommendation.title: Federate snapshots, split profiles
recommendation.body: Keep current snapshot and restoration semantics, design account-scoped identity, deliver cross-snapshot search first, and track named account profiles separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant snapshot, restoration, media-backup, and release history is concentrated in their merged work.
